'''Ham sauce''' (in Italian, '''''Salsa di Prosciutto''''') is a relatively quick and simple sauce used to coat pasta or served over rice. It should not be confused for a glaze for baked ham—rather, it is a sauce on its own that incorporates ham.

== Ingredients ==
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] or [[Cookbook:Prosciutto|prosciutto]], cut into strips
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] purée
* 1 oz [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] vegetable or meat [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]

== Procedure ==
# Melt butter in small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and gently [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] the strips of meat.
# Stir in tomato purée.
# Add stock and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for about 5 minutes.
# Serve over [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] or toss with [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]].
